title: Jimmy Johnson, Bob Lyons, and a gap in playing
summary: He remembers other bassists, recalls following Newton around, and says he stopped playing for twelve to fifteen years.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Do you remember Jimmy Johnson, the bass player?
Jimmy Johnson, yes, I remember him. I remember Jimmy Johnson. Bob Lyons. Who? Bob Lyons. Yeah, yeah, uh-huh.
Do you remember when you heard him? Who was he with there?

Oh, well I don't know, I can't recall who he was playing with at the time, cause I was kind of young you know, and I used to go around. When I used to go to these places I went with Liv, Liv Newton. You know, he carried me around everywhere he played, that's how I come to start the playing bass. And then I got away from it and I didn't play anymore for oh good while after, I may say about twelve, fifteen years. Later on then I picked up the bass again and I started the playing. So now.
